data.title: 冬马和纱 · 耳机里的一段旋律
data.description: 她坐在地毯上听录音，手边摊开的谱纸被压在杯垫下面，免得卷起来。
data.action: sitting on the rug and listening through headphones
data.promptProse: Sitting on a soft wool rug in the corner of an apartment living room, Kazusa Touma wears studio monitor headphones, her eyes closed peacefully with music sheets spread across the floor. A warm floor lamp casts a gentle golden pool of light over her, the scattered sheet music, and a vacuum-tube amplifier on a low table.
